representativeness_note: Full-work source-free morphology diagnostic from independently reviewed SCRIP-MORPH-005 (merge 7dab1a6b0fe2a1d9fe44653a17580e3f6f25145b) and SCRIP-MORPH-006 (merge 1bc8d9f92f6c8ab4bdce0a49ed45095af4579565): 269,358 Scriptorium word tokens; 117,554 conservatively defined POS; 151,804 undefined POS. Of the undefined rows, 59,254 are direct cross-bucket ambiguities. Pinned AOT literature homonym weights uniquely nominate a FantLab-shaped bucket for only 5,972 of those rows (10.0786%); production POS resolution is unchanged. SCRIP-MORPH-008 exact-provider replay also measures FantLab's separately documented 22-category methodology surface without folding it into the current work-page surface: 127,909 rows are conservatively defined there, 10,355 more than the 17-bucket view, consisting of 7,607 infinitives, 1,874 short adjectives, 718 short participles, 156 phrasal verbs and 0 postpositions. The work-page relation remains unknown. These numbers are diagnostic provider-signal evidence, not recovered FantLab rules, displayed FantLab counts or parity evidence.

source.edition_note: ФЭБ. ЭНИ «Лев Толстой»; Толстой Л. Н. Анна Каренина. М.: Наука, 1970. С. 5–684.

fantlab_boundary.note: FantLab displays 253,275 words for an undisclosed analyzer-input edition, while the frozen public candidate currently yields 269,358 Scriptorium word tokens. The +16,083 word difference and POS partition deltas mix source/tokenization and morphology effects, so the public morphology summary must remain diagnostic-only and cannot establish FantLab parity.
